adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the diff shows `usernames.split(",").each do |username|; if user = User.find_by_username(username); group.add(user); end; end` and then it always renders `success_json` on `group.save` (no reporting of unresolved usernames). That means typos/nonexistent usernames are silently ignored with no partial-failure feedback. This is a real, diff-grounded behavior/UX concern, but it’s not a clear correctness defect since silently skipping unknown usernames can be intentional (the previous spec even covered “succeeds silently when adding non-existent users,” though that code path was removed).
